web.named_query: ("Andrew Ferguson" OR "Mark Meador") AI artificial intelligence superintelligence policy statements

summary.text: In May 2025, Ferguson described AI as promising broad gains in innovation, economic growth, worker productivity, and competition with Big Tech incumbents. In September 2025, he advocated regulatory optimism toward AI while supporting intervention when AI is abused to injure consumers and workers. As an FTC commissioner in September 2024, he argued that Congress had not authorized the Commission to regulate AI standing alone, while supporting enforcement against businesses using AI hype to deceive consumers.
